question: Should `CONTRIBUTING.md` use the external OpenClaw people page as the public maintainer roster and remove the inline role/area list?
rationale: This is a public governance source-of-truth change, the PR carries the protected `maintainer` label, and a closely related roster-source PR was previously closed on maintainer-intent grounds.

options.title: Confirm People Page Canonical
options.body: Approve the external people page as the public roster source and merge this focused routing update after proof is adequate.

options.title: Keep Public Role Cues
options.body: Ask for a small revision that preserves public project/area responsibility cues while still reducing stale roster duplication.

options.title: Pause Roster Change
options.body: Close or hold this PR if the inline maintainer-area list should remain the contributor routing contract for now.

recommendation.title: Confirm People Page Canonical
recommendation.body: Approve the external people page as the public roster source and merge this focused routing update after proof is adequate.
